verdict.rationale: Sharing a space and co-editing notes is a fair question for a networked note-taking app, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Reflect lets you share a graph or space with collaborators or edit together with conflict handling. Related features don't qualify: one-click public publishing is read-only, note history is single-user versioning, and iCloud/Git sync is personal sync.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can share a vault or space with collaborators and edit notes together without stepping on each other's changes
